description: Add or subtract a number of working days (Monday to Friday) from a start date, optionally skipping England and Wales bank holidays. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format. Bank holiday data covers 2026 and 2027 only, so outside those years just weekends are skipped. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/add-working-days/

bankHolidays.description: Also skip England and Wales bank holidays, not just weekends (default true)

days.description: Number of working days to move (0 to 100000)

direction.description: 'add' to count forwards, 'sub' to count backwards (default 'add')

name: hopi_add_working_days

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Add working days
